description: The front-door case of PRD-053: a bare Markdown file with no frontmatter gains exactly five keys — type, kind, title from the first ATX heading, aliases recording where the file came from, and prov with the configured operator — and nothing else. The body is byte-identical after adoption, including its blank lines and its trailing LF; one blank line separates the closing fence from it. Keys are in the schema order of AGSC-04-19 — top-level properties first, the concept branch's kind last — so lint --fix never rewrites an adopted file. The file lands at content/concepts/<slug>.md per AGSC-02-93.

expected.body:
# Handoff

An agent passes control to another agent.
expected.output:
---
type: concept
title: Handoff
aliases:
  - notes/handoff.md
prov:
  origin: human
  operator: human:andreibesleaga
kind: explainer
---

# Handoff

An agent passes control to another agent.
